text:
Nadia: Heads-upLegal wants 24 months of auth/session logs "available for inspection." We have 90d raw + 1y redacted today. Need a short, operational pattern: where to archive, KMS separation, JIT escrow access, RBAC changes, and replay throttles.

Ken: Quick idea: move months 90-730 to cold archive bucket (archive-cmk). No daily raw access. Any access must be ticketed and produce an evidence bundle.

Isha: Agreed. Two main access modes: 1) search/redacted index for analysts; 2) timeboxed escrow for raw restores. Escrow flow should mint an ephemeral decrypt token scoped to ticket id and object list. Require MFA + at least one security approver.

Nadia: Ops caveat: replays can spike SIEM ingest. Propose default throttles: 300 events/s per tenant for replay jobs; require SRE coordination for >1M events and force batch manifests for >2M. Also require backpressure handling (429 -> backoff).

Ken: KMS policy note: restrict kms:Decrypt for archive-cmk to unwrap-service principal and condition on request.ticket_id tag. No long-lived creds for unwraps. Persist unwrap audit to immutable audit-bucket for 5y.

Isha: RBAC sketch: create roles: 'archive_requester' (can open ticket), 'archive_approver' (can approve), 'archive_executor' (can run unwrap after approval). 'analyst_redacted' for search-only. Approval must include ticket link & reason; grant requires MFA.

security-bot: Task created: TASK-9944 "Archive escrow flow + replay limits" assigned to Nadia. (automated)

Ken: Example minimal CLI for request:
```
/archivereq --tenant=acme --start=2024-01-01 --end=2024-03-01 --purpose="external audit" --notify=security
```
Approve flow (security):
```
/archapprove REQ-9944 --approver=ken --note="legal validated" --mfa=true
```
On approve, system mints ephemeral token: token_ttl=4h, presigned GETs TTL=10m.

Isha: Implementation notes:
- Presigned URLs for downloads (10m) logged to audit-bucket
- For >2M events: create manifest + staged batch exports; no single-stream restores
- Use object-store server-side filters (S3 Select) to avoid full-file decryption where possible

oncall-sre: Add to runbook:
- Default replay throttle 300 ev/s, configurable per-tenant via ops ticket
- Off-peak scheduling required for jobs >500k events
- Auto-pause job on sustained 5xx/429 from SIEM connector and alert SRE team
- Require cost-center tag and ticket id on every job

Nadia: Audit record schema (minimal): requestor, ticket_id, approvers, unwrap_token_id, objects, bytes_transferred, start_ts, end_ts, job_id. Evidence bundle uploaded to audit-bucket at job completion.

Ken: Action items:
- Ken: PR for KMS key policy + example condition (due 2025-02-01)
- Isha: RBAC RFC + ticket template + UI mock for approvals (due 2025-01-25)
- oncall-sre: runbook edits + replay test harness (due 2025-01-20)
- Nadia: compliance note + retention config to legal (due 2025-01-22)

Please ack.
